docs.title: Entropy Buffer
docs.text:
Hardware-backed entropy for cryptographic operations.

Manages a pre-filled entropy pool using the operating system's CSPRNG for non-blocking random number generation.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• OS CSPRNG — Uses secrets module
  • Pre-buffered — Non-blocking reads
  • Thread-safe — Async-compatible

docs.title: Development Setup
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/vindicta-platform/Entropy-Buffer.git
cd Entropy-Buffer
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
uv pip install git+https://github.com/vindicta-platform/Entropy-Buffer.git

from entropy_buffer import EntropyPool

pool = EntropyPool()
random_bytes = pool.get_bytes(32)
